[USER] User is seeking tips for improving their Mac's battery life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Adjust screen brightness: Lowering the screen brightness can help save power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use energy-saving settings: Check the energy-saving preferences and choose "Better Battery Life" to utilize the Mac more efficiently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Quit unnecessary applications: Quitting apps that aren't in use can save a considerable amount of battery life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Turn off Bluetooth and Wi-Fi: Turning off Bluetooth and Wi-Fi when not in use can help save power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use Safari instead of Chrome: Chrome uses more battery life than Safari, so switch to Safari when possible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Update your software: Always ensure that the Mac's operating system and apps are updated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reduce the use of the keyboard's backlight: Keyboard backlighting can deplete the Mac's battery life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reduce volume and turn off vibration: Reducing volume and vibrations can help conserve battery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Manage battery usage: Check in System Preferences > Energy Saver to manage battery use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a lightweight laptop case: A lightweight and breathable laptop case can offer better ventilation for the device.  
[USER] User finds the tips helpful and expresses surprise at the impact of reducing keyboard backlighting on battery life.
